item1PerFieldZero.improvementValue: SERVE ZERO. Vacant land has a real stored 0. Dispatch measurement: Bastrop 26553 improvement values at stored zero. Collapsing those to absent says we do not know where CAD does know.
item1PerFieldZero.assessedValue: SERVE ZERO. A $0 assessed value can be a real exemption. Absent would invent ignorance.
item1PerFieldZero.marketValue: SERVE ZERO when the key is present. Unusual, but a present 0 is CAD's claim. We have no second derivation that a $0 market value means missing.
item1PerFieldZero.landValue: SERVE ZERO when the key is present. A $0 land value looks like missing data, and that suspicion is recorded on the wire basis, but collapsing present-0 to absent is the three-states violation the card forbids. Do not apply a different bake rule just because the number looks unlikely.
item1PerFieldZero.livingAreaSqft: KEEP POSITIVE-ONLY / ABSENT. Not a dollar field. A 0 sqft living area is not a measured floor; it is the no-building case already told by improvementValue=0. Serving 0 sqft as a present measurement fabricates a floor.
item1PerFieldZero.wireShape: Dollar fields gain state zero {state:'zero', v:0, source, vintage, valueBasis}. present stays v>0. absent stays no v, with basis. cadRollWireNeverUsesZero is retired for dollars; a new check forbids v:0 on state present and forbids v on state absent.
